div.l: And eek here wyves / wolde it wel assente
Or ellis certeyn / they were moche to blame
It wel fayre / to be clepyd madame
And for to gon / to vigilijs al bi fore
And have a mantyl / ryally I bore
A CookA Cook they hadde with hem / for the nonys
To boyle the chekenys / with the mary bonys
And poudre marchaıı̄unt / tart and galantygalanty galyngale
Wel cowde he knowe / a draught of londone ale
He cowde roste / and sethe boyle and frye
Make mortrewes / and wel bake a pye
But gret harm · was / it / as thouht me
That on his shene / a mormale had hee
For blanmager maad / he with the beste
A Shipman̄ A Shipman̄ was ther / wonnyng ferre bi weste
For owȝt I wot / he was of dertemouthe
He rood vp on a roncyn / as he couthe
In a gowne of faldyng / to the kne
A dagger hangyng / by a lace had he
A bowten his necke / vnder hys arm doıı̄un
The hote somer had made / his hewe ful broıı̄un
And Certeynly / he was a good felawe
Wel many a drawht of wyn / hadde he drawe
Fro Burdeus ward / whil the shipman̄ sleep
Of nyce conscience / tok he no kepe
Yif that he fauht / and hadde the hyeere hond
Be water he sente hem home / by every londe
But of his carftis / to reknen wel his tydes ·
His stremes / and his Daıı̄unngeres ther besydes
His herborgh and his mone / and his loodmanage
Ther was noon such / fro hull to Cartage
Hardy he was / and wys to vndirtake
With many a tempest / had his berd be shake
He knewe all the havenys / as they were
Fro scotlond / to the cape / of fynestere
